ops.consoleNote: Staff only. Every action is checked by the database and written to the audit log.

login.title: Staff sign-in
login.lede: Use the email and password from your invitation. A second factor (an authenticator app) is required after this step.
login.notStaff: This account has no active staff role.
login.citizen: Not staff? Sign in as a citizen

mfa.enrollLede: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows. Staff accounts can’t continue without it.
mfa.secret: Or enter this key by hand
mfa.challengeLede: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
mfa.failed: That code didn’t work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lede: What is waiting for you, by role.

c.reasonHelp: Required when rejecting, downgrading or retracting. Kept in the audit log.
c.apiNeeded: This step runs through the ElectraLens API, which isn’t connected in this environment.

datasets.title: Dataset versions
datasets.label: Label
datasets.createdNote: Version created. Upload the file next; it goes to quarantine and is validated by the worker.

runs.title: Audit runs
runs.noApproved: Two approved roll versions of the same area are needed to start a run.

findings.title: Findings review
findings.lede: Review each finding with the restricted evidence. You can’t review findings from a run you started.
findings.evidenceNote: Row-level evidence opens through a 5-minute signed link from the API, and every view is logged.

publications.title: Publications
publications.createNote: The worker prepares the manifest, suppression and privacy scan, then sends it for review.
publications.retractNote: A retraction is recorded and anchored; nothing is deleted.
publications.noRuns: No runs are ready for a publication.

claims.title: Claim moderation
claims.empty: No claims are waiting for moderation.

booths.title: Booths
booths.lede: Booth lists arrive as polling_stations_v1 dataset versions and are published after approval.

methodology.title: Methodology versions
methodology.frozenNote: Frozen versions can never change. A different person from the author must freeze and publish.
methodology.invalidJson: The parameters are not valid JSON.

staff.title: Staff and roles
staff.inviteNote: Invitations are sent by the API with the admin key. New staff must set up an authenticator on first sign-in.
staff.selfNote: You can’t grant roles to yourself.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lede: Append-only. Nobody, including administrators, can change or delete entries.

errors.auth_forbidden: Your role doesn’t allow this action here.
errors.workflow_same_person: The same person can’t take both steps. Ask a colleague.
errors.workflow_run_creator_cannot_review: You started this run, so someone else must review its findings.
errors.workflow_run_creator_cannot_approve: You started this run, so someone else must approve its publication.
errors.workflow_illegal_transition: This item is not in a state where that action is possible.
errors.workflow_findings_unreviewed: Every finding in the run must be reviewed first.
errors.workflow_dataset_not_approved: Both roll versions must be approved.
errors.workflow_methodology_not_frozen: The methodology must be frozen first.
errors.workflow_different_areas: Both rolls must cover the same area.
errors.workflow_baseline_not_earlier: The baseline roll must be the earlier one.
errors.workflow_stale_manifest: The manifest changed since you opened it. Reload and check again.
errors.workflow_publication_in_progress: Another publication in this series is still in progress.
errors.workflow_self_grant: You can’t grant roles to yourself.
errors.workflow_review_first: The review step must be approved first.
